title.narrative: Promoting access to income generation In emergency response

description.narrative: This proposal will be implemented with Caritas Quiche partners (CQ) who have reported thousands of people affected. The target group for this proposal is: 160 families who are living in the municipality of San Andrés Sajcabajá. The main problems prioritized are: severe food insecurity between Sept-Nov, lack of employment opportunities, lack of income activities, early atypical migration, lack of seed to plant in second season, low level of water resources and lack of food for the livestock. The project does not have the capacity to support all the affected people, so partners have selected the most affected. The project will provide support through cash for work [CFW]. The beneficiaries will contribute with labour force to carry out community projects [road, school, church reparation, etc.] and implement agro-ecological farming practices [soil conservation, reforestation]. This proposal builds on the significant experience and capacity of the partner working in some of the most isolated poor communities located in the dry corridor of Guatemala. Also, Caritas Quiche bring considerable experience in the field of DRR and emergency response.
